item.title: Guilt Gets Under the Skin in This Creepy Horror Short Film GRIMA
item.description: Here’s another horror short film for you to check out titled Grima. In the film, after Jen's guilt gets the best of her, she begins to experience grima, or the sensation you get from nails on a chalkboard. She must confront what she did or be consumed by her guilt.The film was written and directed by Richie Harrington.
